text:
Ava: Heads up — there is a mysterious tin of assorted biscuits in the kitchen. Who's it from? :eyes:
Diego: Not me. I only bring bagels, and those have fingerprints. :sweat_smile:
Priya: Could be the 'Office Snack Robin Hood' again. Left them unlabeled like a true snack vigilante. :smile:
Sam: I nominate a bracket to determine the champion biscuit. Quick and dirty — 4 rounds. :trophy:
Kelsey: I will officiate. Seedings: Shortbread vs. Chocolate Chip, Biscotti vs. Lemon Crisp. React with numbers to vote?
Jordan: 1️⃣ for Shortbread, 2️⃣ for Chocolate Chip, 3️⃣ for Biscotti, 4️⃣ for Lemon Crisp. Winner goes into the communal snack hall of fame (and my lunchbox).
Ava: Poll time — react to this thread. Also, please don't take the winner until we finish the bracket. :pleading_face:
lunch-bot: Reminder: office snacks are community property. Please label personal items with your name or put them in the fridge.
Diego: 2️⃣ got my vote. Chocolate chip all the way. :chocolate_bar:
Priya: 3️⃣ biscotti for dunking supremacy. Coffee pairing champion. ☕️
Kelsey: Tallying so far — 2 vs 3. Close match. Keep votes coming before 11:30.
Sam: One-liner tie-breaker if needed: "A biscuit a day keeps the grumpies away." Vote by replying with your favorite pun.
Jordan: "In crumb we trust." :joy:
Ava: "Biscuit to my heart." ok that's terrible, but relevant.
Diego: Update: someone left a tiny sticky note: 'From the QA team. Enjoy :)' Mystery solved?
Priya: QA appreciation squad, bless. :heart:
Kelsey: Final vote — Chocolate chip wins the first match. I'll post the next pairing in 5.
Sam: Winner claimed responsibly? Whoever takes the first box, snap a pic and say which match it beat. For posterity. :camera_with_flash:
Jordan: Will do. Thanks QA team. Instant morale boost. :raised_hands:
